concept.th-function.def: A named bundle of steps you can call and reuse, with inputs and an output.
concept.th-parameter.def: A named input a function receives, which arrives as a local variable when the function is called.
concept.th-return-value.def: The result a function hands back to whatever called it.
concept.th-local-variable.def: A variable that exists only while its function is running.
